entries.title: Kuva Thrall
entries.summary: Your everyday foe: progress, materials, mods

blocks.text: The <hl>{lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}</hl> is this mod's basic enemy and the most common Kuva enemy. Every one you kill yourself brings you a step closer to beating the boss, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}, and may drop materials and mods.
<dim>Names like "Kuva", "Lich" and "mod" come from Warframe. If they are new to you, see the [[start/glossary|glossary]].</dim>
Where to find it

rows: Like zombies: only where it is dark enough, never on <t>Peaceful</t>
It is big: it needs a clear <t>3×3</t> area <t>3</t> blocks high, so it is rare in low caves

blocks.text: How it fights

items: Hits hard: Easy <t>6.8</t>, Normal <t>13.6</t>, Hard <t>20.4</t> per hit
A hit <w>launches you</w>, while the Thrall lunges after you and heals <t>0.8</t>
Half again as fast as a zombie; it comes for you once it sees you within <t>32</t> blocks
Slowly regenerates: <t>1</t> health per second, <t>0.5</t> when it has no target
Picks fights: it attacks other monsters nearby, even neutral ones such as Endermen, and only spares Creepers and other Kuva enemies

items.text: The longer the fight, the harder it hits, see [[enemies/battle_boost]]

blocks.text: Base stats

rows: <t>Undead</t>, but it does not burn in sunlight like zombies

blocks.text: Being undead, it is hurt more by Smite and by the "{lang:item.module.bane_of_undead}" stat on mods, and Healing / Harming potions work the other way round.
Drops

items: <t>Decryption progress</t>: enough of it reveals, one by one, the Requiem cards you need to beat the Lich, see [[requiem/decryption]]. Once all three clues are revealed, kills stop adding progress

<t>Mods</t>: upgrade cards you fit to a weapon or to yourself, see [[modules/module_overview]]. <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv}</t> of dropped mods are weapon mods; the rest are Warframe mods, which you fit to yourself
The three mod tiers share a single roll, so at most one mod drops per kill; tiers: [[modules/module_rarity]]
Kuva, Riven Slivers and Requiem Gems each roll independently; what they are for: [[start/materials]]

blocks.title: You must land the killing blow
blocks.text: Weapons, arrows and thrown items all count as yours. A kill by a pet, another mob or lava does not count, and neither does burning to death, even from your own Fire Aspect or Flame arrows. Then you get no progress and no drops.

In Warframe, Thralls are a Lich's underlings, found in the territory it controls. Finishing them off slowly reveals the Requiem mods needed to defeat the Lich, which is where this mod's decryption progress comes from.
Advanced details

items: Damage formula: 8 × difficulty factor × 0.85, where the factor is 1 on Easy, 2 on Normal and 3 on Hard. Against players, vanilla then applies its own difficulty scaling, then armor
Knockback strength: your horizontal speed ×3, vertical ×2

Elemental kills do not count either: a killing blow from {lang:kuvaweapon.type.fire} burn, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.poison}, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.gas}, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.electricity} or {lang:kuvaweapon.type.explosion} damage gives you nothing. Elements: [[combat/elements]]
Requiem Gems only check Looting on the item in your main hand at the moment of the kill; Fortune does nothing. Shoot it dead with a bow and your main hand holds the bow, so Looting counts as 0
These drops are spawned directly where it fell, so the "{lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.itemDropMultiplier}" stat on Warframe mods does not boost them

entries.title: Kuva Lich
entries.summary: The boss: how to meet it and what winning gives you

blocks.text: The <hl>{lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}</hl> is this mod's boss and the end of the Requiem decryption loop. All your progress and card guessing gets tested on it: guess right and you win a Kuva weapon and other big rewards.
The hunt, step by step

items: Kill Thralls to build [[requiem/decryption|decryption progress]] and reveal the answer bit by bit. Each <t>clue</t> is one <t>Requiem card</t> of the answer; three cards in the right order are the password that defeats the Lich
Put three cards, in the order you guess, into the [[requiem/requiem_gate|Requiem Gate]], the block made for holding them
Find or summon a Lich and land the killing blow yourself
The kill checks your answer: right means rewards, wrong means [[enemies/kuva_escalation|Lich level]] +1

blocks.text: In Warframe, a Kuva Lich is a nemesis unique to each player. Only by fitting three Requiem mods to your Parazon and finishing it with them in the right order do you defeat it for good and win its Kuva weapon.
How to meet it

cells: Spawns in dark Overworld spots like Thralls, except in Mushroom Fields; it is taller and needs a clear <t>3×3</t> area <t>4</t> blocks high
Use a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}: any time, any place, one per summon

blocks.text: Right-click the air with it and the Lich appears <t>3</t> blocks away in the horizontal direction you face, at your foot level; right-click a block and it appears on the clicked face. Creative mode does not use one up.

blocks.title: Summoned Liches can vanish too
blocks.text: It despawns like a wild one: with every player over <t>128</t> blocks away it gets removed; over <t>32</t> blocks from the nearest player and untouched for over <t>30</t> seconds, it can vanish at any moment; on <t>Peaceful</t> it disappears at once. The Ultimatum is not refunded.
Base stats

rows: Fire and falling: burning, lava and {lang:kuvaweapon.type.fire} elemental burn cannot hurt it

blocks.text: How it fights

items: Hits even harder: Easy <t>11.05</t>, Normal <t>22.1</t>, Hard <t>33.15</t> per hit
<w>Area attack</w>: every swing also deals the same damage to every other creature within <t>3</t> blocks of its body, pets and teammates included; only Kuva enemies are spared
A hit <w>sends you flying</w> and heals the Lich <t>2.6</t>
Regeneration per second: <t>2</t> or <t>2%</t> of missing health, whichever is larger, with a target; <t>1</t> or <t>1%</t> without

items.text: The longer the fight, the harder it hits, see [[enemies/battle_boost]]

items: Your damage against it has to get through several reduction layers first, see [[enemies/lich_resistance]]

blocks.text: When it dies

rows: Fewer than 3 cards in the Requiem Gate
<g>Decryption succeeds</g>: rewards below, and a new cycle starts
Decryption fails: [[enemies/kuva_escalation|Lich level]] +1; you still gain progress

items: On success, progress, clues and Lich level all reset, and the next cycle's answer is rolled anew
On failure, chat tells you whether card 1 was right, and card 2 as well if card 1 was; how to test orders: [[requiem/decrypt_failure]]
<w>Until at least one clue is revealed, no answer exists yet, so a full set always fails</w>
In a group fight only the player who lands the last hit counts: their cards are checked and they get the progress

blocks.text: Rewards for a successful decryption

rows: 1 random weapon unique to this mod, its level rolled within your current weapon level range
1; needed to craft three workstations, see [[requiem/requiem_items]]
Always 1: <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.masterPrimeModuleChance|pctv}</t> <c:55FFFF>Prime</c>, otherwise <c:FF55FF>Riven</c>; <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv}</t> of them are weapon mods
Each loses 1 durability; survivors return to your inventory, see [[requiem/requiem_cards]]
Minimum and maximum both rise, see below

items: <c:55FFFF>Prime</c> and <c:FF55FF>Riven</c> are two advanced mod tiers; how they differ: [[modules/module_rarity]]

Weapon level range: minimum and maximum both rise by the same random amount <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevelCapIncrease}-{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevelCapIncrease}</t>; the minimum caps at <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevel}</t>, the maximum at <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevel}</t>, see [[weapons/weapon_level]]
This kill's Kuva weapon is rolled from the range before the increase; the new range applies from your next decryption

blocks.text: Apart from Requiem cards going back to your inventory, every reward <w>drops where the Lich fell</w>, and so do cards that do not fit in your inventory. Do not finish it next to lava or the void.

blocks.title: You must land the killing blow
blocks.text: Only a Lich killed by a player counts; arrows and thrown items are fine. If a pet, another mob or environmental damage finishes it, you get no progress, no rewards, and no decryption attempt.
Advanced details

items: Damage formula: 13 × difficulty factor × 0.85, the same formula as Thralls
Knockback strength: horizontal ×3.15, vertical ×2.15
A killing blow from {lang:kuvaweapon.type.poison}, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.gas}, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.electricity} or {lang:kuvaweapon.type.explosion} elemental damage does not count either
Killing blows from {lang:kuvaweapon.type.slash} damage over time, the "{lang:item.module.execute_threshold}" and "{lang:item.module.execute_chance}" stats, or Kuva weapon effects do count as yours
Rewards are spawned straight onto the ground, so the "{lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.itemDropMultiplier}" stat on Warframe mods does not boost them

entries.title: Lich Level
entries.summary: Each wrong guess adds a level; only success clears it

blocks.text: Your <hl>Lich level</hl> counts your wrong guesses: each time you kill a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} with a wrong set of three cards in place, it goes up by 1 and chat shows the new level.

items: The level belongs to you, not to any particular Lich
Dying does not reset it; only a successful decryption does
Killing a Lich with a full set before any answer card has been revealed also counts as a wrong guess

blocks.text: What it does to you
Each level adds <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.increaseDamage|pct}</t> to the damage Kuva enemies (Thralls and Liches) deal to you. Only theirs: other mobs, falls and lava are unaffected.

header: Damage Kuva enemies deal to you

blocks.text: Each level also cuts your damage to Kuva enemies by <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.reducedDamage|pct}</t>, up to 99.9%; other targets are unaffected.
Your Lich level only counts wrong guesses and does not weaken you: a wrong guess just costs you a success.

blocks.title: Swap cards after a wrong guess
blocks.text: A wrong guess does not take your three cards; they stay in the [[requiem/requiem_gate|Requiem Gate]] that holds them. Kill the next Lich without changing them and the same wrong set fails again, for another +1 level.
How to find the right order in as few tries as possible: [[requiem/decrypt_failure]].
In Warframe, finishing a Lich with the wrong Requiem sequence fails: the Lich survives and ranks up, growing stronger. In this mod, that level is kept on you instead.

entries.title: Battle Boost
entries.summary: The longer a fight lasts, the harder they hit

blocks.text: Kuva enemies get nastier as a fight goes on: <hl>the longer the fight, the more damage they deal</hl>, with no cap. So finish them fast.
Damage dealt by Kuva enemies × (1 + seconds in combat × {cfg:kuva_lich.battleBoost|pct})
How the timer works

items: Every Thrall and Lich keeps its own timer
It starts <w>the moment it locks on</w>, not when blows are exchanged: a Thrall locks on when it sees you within <t>32</t> blocks, a Lich within <t>64</t>
It keeps climbing as long as it has a target: you, your pets, or a mob it is fighting
Without a target it counts back down at the same rate: after 60 seconds of fighting, it takes 60 seconds out of combat to reach zero
The timer is saved with the entity; unloading and reloading the chunk does not clear it

entries.title: Lich Resistances
entries.summary: Why your damage falls off: four layers, one by one

blocks.text: If your damage on a Lich keeps shrinking, you are not imagining it: every hit you land on a Kuva enemy must pass several reduction layers first. Thralls have the first two; the Lich has all four.

rows: Repeated hits of one type stack -5% each, up to -30%
The more hits within 2 seconds, the less each does, down to 40%
The part above <t>15%</t> of max health is heavily compressed

blocks.title: Only raw damage is reduced
blocks.text: These layers only reduce the hit's raw damage: weapon attack damage, enchantments, jump crits. Mod stats, mod crits and elemental multipliers are applied after the layers, so the soft cap never touches them, see [[combat/damage]].
1. Damage type modifier

rows: The thing that hit it is an arrow: bow arrows, crossbow bolts, thrown tridents
Any other damage counted as a projectile: snowballs, other mods' projectiles, etc.
Potions, Thorns and other magic damage, plus mod spells recognised as magic
A living creature hit it directly: your own swings, pets and summons
None of the above: explosions, lightning, burning, etc.

blocks.text: Types are checked from top to bottom; the first match wins. Layer 2 keeps separate stacks for these same five types.
2. Adaptive resistance (Lich)
The Lich "adapts" to how you fight: the more you use one damage type, the more that type gets reduced.

items: Each of the five types keeps its own stacks
On every hit, damage is first reduced by that type's current stacks, <t>5%</t> each; then that type gains a stack. So the first hit is not reduced
Up to 6 stacks, i.e. -30% for that type
No hit of a type for <t>4-5</t> seconds: that type loses a stack, then one more every <t>5</t> seconds
No damage of any kind for over <t>10</t> seconds: every type resets to zero

blocks.text: <g>Rotating damage types</g> pays off: melee for a while, switch to the bow, then spells, and let the idle types bleed stacks. <w>Switching weapons is not switching types</w>: two swords are both melee and share one counter.
Warframe has a Warframe mod called Adaptation: taking damage builds up resistance to that damage type. The Lich's adaptive resistance runs on the same idea, only on an enemy.
3. Burst diminishing (Lich)
The more hits it takes in a short time, the less each one hurts.
Damage multiplier = max(40%, 1 − hits already taken in the last 2 seconds × 5%)

blocks.title: What counts as a hit
blocks.text: <w>Every hit that actually lands counts</w> and adds a stack: every tick of {lang:kuvaweapon.type.poison} / {lang:kuvaweapon.type.gas} damage over time, the extra {lang:kuvaweapon.type.electricity} / {lang:kuvaweapon.type.explosion} damage, Thorns, pet attacks... Uncharged swings count too. The more damage over time you bring, the lower your main hits sink.
4. Soft damage cap (Lich)
When a single hit is too big, the excess is heavily compressed. So the higher your weapon's own attack damage, the harder it gets squashed.
Threshold = max health × 15% (default 200 × 15% = 30); above it: damage = threshold + ln(1 + excess × 0.5) ÷ 0.5

header: Hit after the first three layers

blocks.text: Advanced details

items: Attacks fully blocked by hit invulnerability do not count as a hit
{lang:kuvaweapon.type.slash} elemental damage over time removes health directly: it skips every layer, adds no stacks and takes no burst slot

items.text: All damage from these mods counts as magic: <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.magicDamageNamespaces|list}</t>

items: Ways around all of these layers: [[enemies/lich_tactics]]

entries.title: Hunting the Lich
entries.summary: Putting it together: prepare, deal damage, finish

blocks.text: This page turns the mechanics above into a plan: prepare before the fight, work around the reductions while dealing damage, and land the final blow yourself. Follow it to avoid the common mistakes.
Before the fight

items: Check that the three cards in the [[requiem/requiem_gate|Requiem Gate]] are the order you want to test. With fewer than three it is just a progress run; with no clue revealed a full set always fails
Bring at least two or three damage types: a melee weapon + a bow or crossbow + spells, ideally a [[weapons/kuva_weapons|Kuva weapon]] with strong mod multipliers
Pick flat, open ground away from pets and villagers: its area attack hits everything within 3 blocks, and the knockback can throw you off a cliff

items.text: To choose the arena, summon it there with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}

blocks.text: Dealing damage

items: <g>Bows and crossbows first</g>: Arrow is the only type with ×1.25, and it stacks separately from melee
Rotate types every few hits so no type reaches 6 stacks
Pacing beats speed: from the 13th hit within 2 seconds you deal only 40%, so one fully charged hit beats two half-charged ones
Don't push raw damage per hit far past 30 (at default health): the excess is almost entirely eaten by the soft cap, so invest in mod multipliers instead

items.text: <w>Finish fast</w>: its damage keeps rising with every second of combat, +<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.battleBoost|pct}</t> per second, see [[enemies/battle_boost]]

blocks.text: Getting around the resistances

items: "{lang:item.module.execute_threshold}" and "{lang:item.module.execute_chance}" stats: when they trigger the target simply dies, the Lich included (see [[reference/weapon_attr_special]])

Damage that removes health directly: {lang:kuvaweapon.type.slash} elemental damage over time and the damage-over-time effects of some [[weapons/weapon_list|Kuva weapons]]. It skips every layer and adds no stacks or burst hits

blocks.title: With guns
blocks.text: TACZ bullets resolve as Other (×1). Each bullet registers as two hits, even when one part deals 0 damage, so burst diminishing and adaptive stacks climb twice as fast. The extra damage from the "{lang:item.module.true_bullet}" stat removes health directly, bypassing the resistances.
Finishing

items: At low health switch to direct attacks for the kill; do not let {lang:kuvaweapon.type.poison}, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.gas}, {lang:kuvaweapon.type.electricity} or {lang:kuvaweapon.type.explosion} damage wear it down, because that kill does not count
Finishing it with {lang:kuvaweapon.type.slash} damage over time, an execution / instant kill or a Kuva weapon effect does count as yours
Group hunts: only the player who lands the last hit counts, using their cards and progress
